Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet 3x3 Tile Mirror Decor, 36 Inch Height, Gold Finish
Colors: Glass
Materials: glass
Small squares fused together to create three mirrored panels. The simple design paired with the striking gold finish makes it perfect for a living room, bedroom, or hallway. 36" x 36" Modern design with touch of glam Glass, iron with gold finish Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
